purpose: TEST / MEASUREMENT DATA ONLY. An external (Turnitin) highlight benchmark for one TurnitPlus submission. Production code must never read this file, and nothing here is ever a scoring input: only verified source text may change a TurnitPlus score.

turnitin.red: NO_CITATION — no in-text citation and no quotation marks
turnitin.yellow: MISSING_CITATION — quotation marks but no in-text citation
turnitin.orange: MISSING_QUOTES — remains very similar to the source (missing quotation marks)
turnitin.green: QUOTED — not present in this report

turnitplus.red: verified source-text overlap that counts in the similarity score
turnitplus.yellow: possible match — source could not be fully verified; NOT counted in the similarity score

colorSemantics.note: The two palettes are NOT equivalent. Turnitin colours are citation categories of matched text; TurnitPlus colours are verification states. Never map one onto the other.

provenance.extraction: pdfjs-dist 6.2.108 (repo node_modules) operator list: filled-rectangle geometry + colour tracked through save/restore/transform; word geometry from showText glyph advances (text state tracked); a word takes the highlight category whose rectangle contains its glyph centres (majority of glyphs). Legend colours read from the report's own page-2 swatches. Source numbers from the numbered badges Turnitin draws at the start of each match (reading order). Page stamp, the DOCX footer page numbers and badge digits excluded.
provenance.alignment: both manuscripts tokenized with the repo's tokenSpans()/tokensForScoringNormalization() (v1, the contract live when the report was generated); TurnitPlus manuscript = the TurnitPlus report PDF Section 2 body text (10,513 tokens, 101 red = the report's own figures); Greedy String Tiling (min 4 tokens, block moves allowed: Turnitin shows footnotes per page, TurnitPlus at the end) + in-order LCS gap fill.
